description: Inject Bedrock-accurate transient errors (503/429/529) into an LLM gateway's upstream calls via a provider-agnostic injector, driven by SSM Parameter Store. Works for self-hosted LiteLLM and AWS-managed AgentCore Gateway without changing the calling application.

injectBedrockGatewayFault.description: Toggle the injector into fault mode for a bounded window, with guaranteed rollback

parameters.documentArn: arn:aws:ssm:<YOUR REGION>:<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:document/<YOUR AUTOMATION DOCUMENT NAME>
parameters.documentParameters: {"InjectorId": "<YOUR INJECTOR ID>", "FaultType": "503", "FaultRate": "0.5", "LatencyMs": "0", "DurationSeconds": "900", "AutomationAssumeRole": "arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR SSM AUTOMATION IAM ROLE NAME>"}

stopConditions.value: arn:aws:cloudwatch:<YOUR REGION>:<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:alarm:<YOUR APPLICATION ERROR RATE ALARM NAME>

roleArn: arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR FIS IAM ROLE NAME>
